subject: Usage profile + budget qualification — pilot credits & next steps
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Linda Park <linda@finpilot.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:12:00Z
Subject: Usage profile + budget qualification — pilot credits & next steps

Hi Linda — thanks again for the productive call earlier. Quick recap and a few asks so we can scope the pilot and get finance to approve credits.

Call recap:
- Pilot objective: verify inference latency at 95th percentile and validate unit economics for our fraud-detection model serving (generation + short-context embeddings).
- Expected steady-state usage: you estimated ~15–25M tokens/month initially, with occasional spikes to ~40M in peak trading windows.
- Typical sequence lengths: average ~120 tokens per request, peak ~400 tokens for detailed audit traces.
- Target unit economics: you indicated you want landed cost to be in the <$200 per 1M tokens neighborhood (on average).

Open asks (can you confirm these?):
1) Confirm the monthly token range you want Redwood to use for pricing scenarios (e.g., 10/20/30M buckets).
2) Confirm whether embeddings are required for the pilot or just text-gen endpoints.
3) Any compliance docs we should prepare up-front (SOC2 evidence, IP handling notes)?

Proposed short-term plan / next steps:
- We can provision a 30-day pilot with managed routing to our US region and a canary rollout.
- Preliminary credit offer: 35,000 trial credits to cover smoke tests + early ramp (I’ll confirm exact tokens-equivalent once pricing profile is locked).
- I’ve attached a draft pilot terms doc for scope and SLAs (pilot_terms_redwood_v1.pdf). Please review and flag anything blocking.
- If that profile looks right, can we schedule a 30-minute follow-up next Tue/Thu to lock on token buckets and security handoff?

Thanks — I’ll wait on your confirmation of the three items above and preferred meeting time.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: pilot_terms_redwood_v1.pdf (1 page stub — scope, success metrics, basic SLA)
From: Linda Park <linda@finpilot.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Usage profile + budget qualification — pilot credits & next steps

Thanks, Stephanie — appreciated the clear recap. Quick answers below and a couple notes from our side.

Answers:
- Monthly token buckets: please base scenarios on 10M / 20M / 40M. We expect to start around ~18–22M and want to understand cost at 40M headroom.
- Pilot scope: embeddings will be needed for enrichment, but only a subset of traffic (≈15% of requests). Main focus is text-gen latency.
- Compliance: SOC2 report is the immediate ask; we may need additional encryption/KMS details if the pilot moves to PII-containing traces.

Budget guidance:
- We have an internal budget band of $8k–$18k/month for inference costs during pilots. That maps to an expectation that unit costs (all-in) stay < $350 per 1M tokens given our current finance assumptions. If Redwood can get closer to $200/1M at scale that’s a compelling outcome.

Credits request:
- A 30-day pilot credit bucket would be very helpful. The team prefers credits that cover both gen and embeddings.

Schedule:
- Tue or Thu next week works for a 30-min sync. I’ll send a calendar invite once you propose a couple slots.

—
Linda Park
Head of Platform Engineering, FinPilot
linda@finpilot.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Linda Park <linda@finpilot.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Usage profile + budget qualification — pilot credits & next steps

Thanks for the quick answers, Linda — that helps a lot. Two items I’m moving on this morning:

1) Credits & economics
- We can provision an initial one-off pilot credit package: 35,000 Redwood credits (covers gen + embeddings) valid for 30 days from activation. At our standard trial conversion, that should cover the expected smoke tests and first ramp (I’ll convert to a token-equivalent after internal pricing confirmation).
- For pricing scenarios we’ll model 10/20/40M buckets and show you the per-1M-token run-rate with and without batching/kv-caching savings (expect a material delta at 40M).

2) Security/compliance handoff
- I’ll loop in our security docs and push them to the Drive link I shared. SOC2 summary will be attached before the next sync.

3) Scheduling
- Proposed slots: Tue 2026-11-09 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 2026-11-11 13:00–13:30 PT. Which works for you?

I’ve attached the pilot terms draft again for edits. If you’re good with the credit amount I’ll request an internal approval today and update you when it’s signed off.

Best,
Stephanie
